newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar on Wednesday on the back of liquidity tightening in late trading, dealers said.
One foreign bank dealer said sentiment on the rupiah also strengthened in late trading as the central bank had unexpectedly kept the fixing rate unchanged since Monday.
"The central bank has surprised the market by keeping the fixing rate unchanged for three days. The bank usually raises the rate three times a week," another bank dealer said.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,424/2,616 and its conversion band at 2,424/2,472 on Wednesday.

Dealers said the central bank's move prompted some overseas dollar selling which partly helped the local currency to strengthen to 2431.00/31.25 at 1015 GMT from around 2432.00/2432.50 level in early trading.
Spot rupiah rate was quoted at 2431.25/32.00 at the opening.
Dealers said the spot rate was likely to remain within a tight range of between 2432.00 and 2432.50 on Thursday as rupiah liquidity was likely to stay sufficient.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,430.85/31.35 and 2,421.50/31.80, respectively.
Overnight swaps were at 0.25/0.35 and tom/next at 0.22/0.27 points.
Dealers said the month-end and half-year book closing factors did not seem to have much impacts on the market.
They said the factors would only have strong impacts on rupiah liquidity starting next week.
One-month swaps were at 14.00/14.75, two at 28.00/30.00, three at 43.00/45.00 and six at 87.25/88.00 points.
